items.q: Is memory like an accurate video recording?
items.correct: No — memory is reconstructive and can be distorted.
items.misconception: Yes, it stores events exactly as they happened.
items.random_wrong: Long-term memory has a small, fixed capacity.
items.why: Memories can be altered (e.g. by leading questions); long-term memory is effectively unlimited.

items.q: Are short-term and long-term memory the same store?
items.correct: No — STM is small and brief; LTM is vast and long-lasting.
items.misconception: Yes, they are one single store.
items.why: The multi-store model separates STM (~7 items, ~18-30s) from LTM.
